findings.text: The new cumulative-archive section omits data-evidence-origin="append", which the sibling section at line 22 carries; reckon/evidence.py treats an unmarked section as one it cannot tell from its own and reports it as 'carried' for an operator to remove on the next synthesis, so this measurement can be flagged as stale rather than recognised as an append.

Every number in the section is produced by census.py, census/make_figure.py and census/receipt_census.py, instruments that survive only in the run directory under the worker's crew home and are not committed, so the record cannot be re-derived from the repository alone; the worker's own outside_scope records this, and the baseline reproduction is the control that makes the one-off instrument trustworthy.
